panels.description: Time Resolution is in 5 min increments

targets.expr:
sum_over_time(
  (
    (sum by (instance)((ubntStaTxAirtime{instance=~"$AP_Instances"} + ubntStaRxAirtime{instance=~"$AP_Instances"}) / 10) > 85)
    /
    (sum by (instance)((ubntStaTxAirtime{instance=~"$AP_Instances"} + ubntStaRxAirtime{instance=~"$AP_Instances"}) / 10) > 85)
  )[72h:5m]
)*5
#mulitply by 5 (same as interval) to convert from count to minutes
